choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Service is your gift to give.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You bow your head and serve.

demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Even small duties shape a prophet.
Do what is set before you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Light glows on your face.

night_falls.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You lie down. Then a voice: "Samuel."
It must be Eli calling you.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Run to Eli to answer him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You hurry through the dim hall.
[TODO:pt-BR] A call answered is a heart awake.
[TODO:pt-BR] Honor the elder with your steps.

ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A voice that calls deserves an answer.
Rise and go to Eli.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Run to Eli to answer him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You step into the corridor.

shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Do not shout in the holy house.
Go to him on quiet feet.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Run to Eli to answer him
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You walk softly to his door.

second_call.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "I did not call you, my son."
You return. The voice comes again.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Doubt your own ears and sleep
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] A whisper this clear is real.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Curse the voice as a trick
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Do not slander what you don't know.
[TODO:pt-BR] Faithful steps in the dark.

doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The voice was not a dream.
Go to Eli and tell him again.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You rise once more.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Guard Your Tongue
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] You do not yet know the speaker.
Go seek Eli's wisdom.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You bow your head and go.

third_call.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Eli Understands
third_call.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Eli's old eyes soften with knowing.
"It is the Lord who calls you."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Do not flee the voice of God.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Go back and wait to listen
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Eli's hand rests on your shoulder.

refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The Lord chose this quiet hour.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Go back and wait to listen
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You return to the dark room.

respond_god.text:

Your heart trembles in the stillness.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Answer Him as Eli taught.

sign_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] His call is the sign itself.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You whisper into the dark.

prophet_calling.text:
